exposure: bleeding disorders (type 1 von Willebrand disease, hemophilia A)
antenatal recommendations from anesthesiology and hematology
cohort: The study included 82 deliveries in 56 pregnant individuals with inherited bleeding disorders managed at a tertiary care center between January 2010 and July 2021.
finding: With multidisciplinary planning and evidence-aligned laboratory targets, neuraxial analgesia was safely offered to most pregnant individuals with bleeding disorders in this cohort, with no epidural or spinal hematomas observed.
